entities.name: Galed
entities.description: One of daen Dwynen's elite warriors of the Gilt-Leaf on Lorwyn, a member of Dwynen's elf pack.

entities.name: Dwynen
entities.description: Gilt-Leaf daen whose pack of elves hunted eyeblights and boggarts on Lorwyn.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: Elven faction on Lorwyn to which Galed and Dwynen belong.

entities.description: The form Lorwyn takes after the Great Aurora.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker who arrived on Lorwyn and was forced to join the elves' hunt.

entities.name: Boggarts
entities.description: Innocent creatures hunted and killed by Dwynen's pack.

events.summary: Nissa Revane arrives on Lorwyn and is confronted by Dwynen's pack of elves, including Galed.
events.quote: she was confronted by Dwynen's pack of elves, including Galed.

events.summary: The elves force Nissa to join their hunt of eyeblights, and she realizes they are killing innocent boggarts.
events.quote: she realized that Dwynen's pack was hunting and killing innocent boggarts

events.summary: The Great Aurora changes Lorwyn to Shadowmoor and Nissa planeswalks away.
events.quote: the Great Aurora arrived and changed Lorwyn to Shadowmoor, and Nissa planeswalked away.
